query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total!", SUM(CASE WHEN uploaded_tiktok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tiktok_uploads, SUM(CASE WHEN uploaded_youtube THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS youtube_uploads, SUM(CASE WHEN uploaded_instagram THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS instagram_uploads FROM twitch_clips_social_media c WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR c.streamer_login = $1)
